tasks.title: Add bookmark creation endpoint and UI

completion.summary: Implemented POST /api/bookmarks endpoint with duplicate detection and BookmarkForm + BookmarkList React components. Used react-hot-toast for notifications.

broken_assumptions.assumption: POST /api/bookmarks returns 201 with the created bookmark object including id, url, title, folderId, and createdAt fields
broken_assumptions.reality: POST /api/bookmarks returns 201 with the created bookmark object but the field is named 'folder_id' (snake_case) not 'folderId' (camelCase) because the ORM returns database column names directly

completion.notes: The ORM (Drizzle) returns snake_case column names by default. The response includes folder_id instead of folderId. Downstream tasks that parse the API response need to use snake_case field names.

drift_log.summary: T01 completed with structural drift: the ORM (Drizzle) returns snake_case column names by default, so the API response uses folder_id and created_at instead of the planned folderId and createdAt. Scanned pending tasks T02, T03, T04. All three reference the affected field names. Updated file descriptions in T04 to use folder_id instead of folderId where they reference API response fields. Added drift-response notes to all three tasks documenting the snake_case convention. Decisions sections (which also reference folderId) were not modified per agent rules — notes alert implementing agents to the discrepancy.
